text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the current alternate side parking arrangement operating on Thursdays only, April through November, on Nina Street and Melgund Road, to allow parking to alternate sides on a monthly basis, April through November. The proposed change will require residents to move their vehicles from one side of the street to the other on a less frequent basis. However, it may impact the level of street cleaning service.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the parking regulations outlined in Appendix A attached to the report (March 23, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District. 2. Enact the parking regulations outlined in Appendix B attached to the report (March 23, 2018) from the Acting Director, Transportation Services, Toronto and East York District.
